prompt: 参考图中的短棕发、绿色短外套女冒险者自然地向右奔跑，正常速度，流畅的手绘游戏动画。侧面全身跟拍，人物完整入镜，纯洋红色背景。
acceptance: Review original-speed source for sustained running before any sprite preparation. No time acceleration to claim a valid gait.

review.running_observed: Visible running action after about 1.2 seconds, unlike the previous slow-stepping candidate.
review.directional_issue: Consecutive source frames show pronounced changes between front-oblique and rear-oblique torso views (e.g. frames 58/72 versus 84/114). Stable lateral viewpoint and a complete identity-consistent loop are not accepted.
